summary_md: **Shorya Mishra ([@SMishra61](https://x.com/SMishra61/status/2116126467411292614))** summarizes *A Reality Check of Inference-Time Context Augmentation Methods* ([arXiv 2610.30983](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30983)): across 5 methods, 7 models and 3 datasets, extra context changed answers without improving reliability, with gains offset by right-to-wrong flips.

referenced_urls.title: A Reality Check of Inference-Time Context Augmentation Methods

relevance: Caution on context stuffing in agent pipelines.
